objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: we can swap the roles of $c$ and $e$ by symmetry (the inequality is symmetric in $x,y$ up to the roles of $c,e$ and the sign of the linear term)
objection.witness: The 'swap the roles of c and e by symmetry' step is justified only by a vague parenthetical; inequality (4) is not symmetric in x,y, and one must instead re-apply (4) with x taken from the e-orbit and y from the c-orbit. The relabelling does work, but is not spelled out.
